score_note: Donationware: a nag screen until a donation code is entered.
description: An acoustic drum kit sampler with a multi-layered rock and pop kit (kick, snare, toms, hi-hats and cymbals), its own mixer and a groove library of thousands of patterns and fills to build a drum track from. Free, closed source donationware: it shows a nag screen until you enter a donation code. VST3 only; the samples come inside the 116 MB bundle.
name: MT Power DrumKit 2

linux-x86_64.post_install_notes: It keeps its settings in ~/.config/MANDA_AUDIO; Uninstall leaves that folder.
